recommendations.label: Data license declared
recommendations.fix: Add a LICENSE file and declare rdip:dataLicense with a SPDX identifier (e.g. CC-BY-4.0).

recommendations.label: Image digest pinned
recommendations.fix: Pin your Docker image to a specific digest: FROM image@sha256:<digest>.

recommendations.label: Random seed declared
recommendations.fix: Declare all random seeds used in training or data splitting as rdip:RandomSeed instances.

recommendations.label: Dataset landing page declared
recommendations.fix: Add rdip:datasetLandingPage linking to where your dataset can be accessed.

recommendations.label: Method declared
recommendations.fix: Link your ResearchActivity to an rdip:Method instance describing the algorithm used.

recommendations.label: Workflow language declared
recommendations.fix: Declare rdip:workflowLanguage on your Method (e.g. Python, Snakemake, Nextflow).

recommendations.label: Evaluation result linked
recommendations.fix: Link your reported metrics to rdip:EvaluationResult instances with rdip:metricName and rdip:metricValue.
